name: Wood Domains 30
notes: Plank wood as oriented angular grain domains: coarse patches each filled with elongated sub-cells aligned to that patch's own direction. Rings were rejected - an iconic bullseye recurs visibly under a non-rotating dual mask. TONAL dual-gate: the mask is the tone-mapped texture field itself, not a threshold cut, so the stroke carries the texture as graded alpha and a window from a stroke matches the designed height field. The level number is the damage/modulation DEPTH (contrast dial): damage is a delta from the intact material, so moderate damage = moderate contrast - per review. Two deconvolutions bind the stroke to the design (docs/fractal-texture-math.md): the spectral 1/H pre-compensation on the field's fbm band, and the value-curve inverse v = 1-(depth*damage)^(1/n) that undoes the mask train's ~n-stamp over-compositing. Threshold-cut coverage masks were the first shipped form and were revised on review (maximal contrast everywhere, stroke windows unlike the swatch fields). Mapping modulate: grain slivers as flat tones. Subtle grain shading. Tips from tips/wood-domains.spec.json; audited by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
